'use client' import * as React from 'react' import { NimbusRoot } from './NimbusStyles' export type NimbusHeroProps = { className?: string } export function NimbusHero({ className }: NimbusHeroProps) { const sectionRef = React.useRef(null) React.useEffect(() => { const el = sectionRef.current if (!el) return const reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches if (reduce) return const onMove = (e: MouseEvent) => { const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect() const x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100 const y = ((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100 el.style.setProperty('--nm-mx', `${x}%`) el.style.setProperty('--nm-my', `${y}%`) } el.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove) return () => el.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove) }, []) return (
